title: Getting Started with mighty.component
text: component reusable code template one data transformation step. code takes input data set returns new changed columns rows. Mustache placeholders, {{{domain}}}, filled component rendered, template works across studies. Roxygen-like tags, @title, @param @depends, document component , needs creates. Components commonly used build ADaM (Analysis Data Model) programs. component handles one derivation, several components make program. mighty ecosystem, mighty.metadata provides study configuration (via mighty_study() _study.yml) controls components rendered parameters.

title: Getting Started with mighty.component
text: minimal component creates column two times existing column: template syntax described .
code: #' @title Double a column #' @description #' Creates a new column as two times an existing column. #' #' @param domain `character` Name of the domain #' @param output `character` Name of the new column #' @param input `character` Name of the existing column #' @type column #' @origin Derived #' @method Two times the input column #' @depends {{{domain}}} {{{input}}} #' @outputs {{{output}}} #' @code {{{domain}}} <- {{{domain}}} |>   dplyr::mutate(     {{{output}}} = 2 * {{{input}}}   )

title: Getting Started with mighty.component
text: template starts tags roxygen comments (#'). lines @code tag R code. Templates use Mustache placeholders. $render() fills whisker::whisker.render(). {{{name}}} inserts value parameter name. Always use triple braces. Double braces ({{name}}) HTML-escape value, e.g. <b becomes <b. {{#name}}...{{/name}} repeats enclosed text element vector name. Use {{{.}}} insert current element.

title: Getting Started with mighty.component
text: tag continues next tag. Required tags must appear exactly . @origin must one Assigned, Collected, Derived, Available, , Predecessor, Protocol. @depends split first space domain column. use spaces inside placeholders, e.g. use {{{domain}}}, {{{ domain }}}.

title: Getting Started with mighty.component
text: Rendering fills placeholders values. $render() takes one named argument per @param tag returns mighty_component_rendered object. Every placeholder now name: rendered code validated: must valid R, joins must specify (see Automatic code validation). Columns checked. Use get_test_component() (see Testing components) run component real data. get_rendered_component() retrieves renders one step. takes parameters named list: missing parameter raises error:

Parameter names not matching component requirements: #> ✖ `variable` not specified #> ✖ `date` not specified

title: Getting Started with mighty.component
text: $eval() runs code. default runs calling environment. Use envir argument choose another environment. code assigns result back domain (e.g., ADAE <- ADAE |> ...), ADAE updated without assigning return value. ASTDY exist yet. Run rendered component: $stream() appends code R script instead:
code: ADAE <- pharmaverseadam::adae |>   dplyr::select(USUBJID, ASTDT, TRTSDT)  names(ADAE) #> [1] "USUBJID" "ASTDT"   "TRTSDT" ady_rendered$eval() names(ADAE) #> [1] "USUBJID" "ASTDT"   "TRTSDT"  "ASTDY" head(ADAE) #> # A tibble: 6 × 4 #>   USUBJID     ASTDT      TRTSDT     ASTDY #>   <chr>       <date>     <date>     <dbl> #> 1 01-701-1015 2014-01-03 2014-01-02     2 #> 2 01-701-1015 2014-01-03 2014-01-02     2 #> 3 01-701-1015 2014-01-09 2014-01-02     8 #> 4 01-701-1023 2012-08-07 2012-08-05     3 #> 5 01-701-1023 2012-08-07 2012-08-05     3 #> 6 01-701-1023 2012-08-07 2012-08-05     3 script_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".R") ady_rendered$stream(script_file) readLines(script_file) #>  [1] "ADAE <- ADAE |>"                        #>  [2] "  dplyr::mutate("                       #>  [3] "    ASTDY = admiral::compute_duration(" #>  [4] "      start_date = TRTSDT,"             #>  [5] "      end_date = ASTDT,"                #>  [6] "      in_unit = 'days',"                #>  [7] "      out_unit = 'days',"               #>  [8] "      add_one = TRUE"                   #>  [9] "    )"                                  #> [10] "  )"

title: Getting Started with mighty.component
text: Write components .mustache files. component derives ratio analysis value baseline: Save template r2base.mustache. load, render run :
code: #' @title Ratio to baseline #' @description #' Derives the ratio of the analysis value to the baseline value. #' #' @param domain `character` Name of the domain #' @param variable `character` Name of the new ratio variable #' @type column #' @origin Derived #' @method Ratio of AVAL to BASE #' @depends {{{domain}}} AVAL #' @depends {{{domain}}} BASE #' @outputs {{{variable}}} #' @code {{{domain}}} <- {{{domain}}} |>   dplyr::mutate(     {{{variable}}} = dplyr::if_else(BASE != 0, AVAL / BASE, NA_real_)   ) r2base <- get_component(r2base_file) r2base #> <mighty_component/R6> #> r2base: Ratio to baseline #> Type: column #> Parameters: #> • domain: `character` Name of the domain #> • variable: `character` Name of the new ratio variable #> Depends: #> • {{{domain}}}.AVAL #> • {{{domain}}}.BASE #> Outputs: #> • {{{variable}}} r2base_rendered <- r2base$render(   domain = "ADLB",   variable = "R2BASE" ) r2base_rendered$code #> [1] "ADLB <- ADLB |>"                                               #> [2] "  dplyr::mutate("                                              #> [3] "    R2BASE = dplyr::if_else(BASE != 0, AVAL / BASE, NA_real_)" #> [4] "  )" ADLB <- pharmaverseadam::adlb |>   dplyr::filter(PARAMCD == "ALB") |>   dplyr::select(USUBJID, PARAMCD, AVISIT, AVAL, BASE)  head(ADLB) #> # A tibble: 6 × 5 #>   USUBJID     PARAMCD AVISIT                 AVAL  BASE #>   <chr>       <chr>   <chr>                 <dbl> <dbl> #> 1 01-701-1015 ALB     Baseline                 38    38 #> 2 01-701-1015 ALB     Week 2                   39    38 #> 3 01-701-1015 ALB     POST-BASELINE MAXIMUM    39    38 #> 4 01-701-1015 ALB     Week 4                   38    38 #> 5 01-701-1015 ALB     Week 6                   37    38 #> 6 01-701-1015 ALB     POST-BASELINE MINIMUM    37    38  r2base_rendered$eval()  ADLB |>   dplyr::select(USUBJID, PARAMCD, AVISIT, AVAL, BASE, R2BASE) |>   head() #> # A tibble: 6 × 6 #>   USUBJID     PARAMCD AVISIT                 AVAL  BASE R2BASE #>   <chr>       <chr>   <chr>                 <dbl> <dbl>  <dbl> #> 1 01-701-1015 ALB     Baseline                 38    38  1     #> 2 01-701-1015 ALB     Week 2                   39    38  1.03  #> 3 01-701-1015 ALB     POST-BASELINE MAXIMUM    39    38  1.03  #> 4 01-701-1015 ALB     Week 4                   38    38  1     #> 5 01-701-1015 ALB     Week 6                   37    38  0.974 #> 6 01-701-1015 ALB     POST-BASELINE MINIMUM    37    38  0.974

title: Getting Started with mighty.component
text: component repo collection components. get_component(), find_component() list_components() take repos argument one repo specs: local directory, e.g. "inst/components" "local::inst/components". GitHub repository, e.g. "github::owner/repo/subdir@ref". Requires gh remotes packages. Raw files URL, e.g. "url::https://example.com/components". Requires httr2 (>= 1.2.2). component name file <name>.mustache <name>.R, either directly repo directory <name>/. See ?mighty_repo details. Put r2base component team repo, together modified copy ady: Several repos searched order, first match wins. ady found team repo: Reverse order use ady examples: find_component() returns NULL repo contains component. get_component() raises error: list_components(= "tibble") returns metadata component. requires tibble tidyr packages: character vector converted repos call. Use mighty_repos() create repos reuse . GitHub URL repos need network access: See ?mighty_repo_github ?mighty_repo_url authentication retries.
code: examples <- system.file("examples", package = "mighty.component") team_repo <- tempfile("team") dir.create(team_repo) invisible(file.copy(r2base_file, team_repo))  ady_template <- readLines(file.path(examples, "ady.mustache")) ady_template[[1]] <- "#' @title Analysis relative day (team version)" writeLines(ady_template, file.path(team_repo, "ady.mustache")) repos <- c(team_repo, examples) list_components(repos) #> [1] "ady"    "r2base" get_component("ady", repos = repos)$title #> [1] "Analysis relative day (team version)" get_component("ady", repos = rev(repos))$title #> [1] "Analysis relative day" is.null(find_component("adt", repos = repos)) #> [1] TRUE get_component("adt", repos = repos) #> Error in `get_component()`: #> ! Component `adt` not found list_components(repos, as = "tibble") |>   dplyr::select(id, title, type, origin) #> # A tibble: 2 × 4 #>   id     title                                type   origin  #>   <chr>  <chr>                                <chr>  <chr>   #> 1 ady    Analysis relative day (team version) column Derived #> 2 r2base Ratio to baseline                    column Derived repos <- mighty_repos(c(   "github::owner/repo/components@main",   "url::https://example.com/components",   examples )) get_component("ady", repos = repos)

text: Rendered code validated. must valid R, joins dplyr, tidylog dbplyr must specify . Implicit joins common source bugs key columns differ studies. component fails validation: Specify join key fix :
code: #' @title Bad join example #' @description Implicit join that will fail validation. #' #' @param domain `character` Name of the domain #' @type row #' @origin Derived #' @method Implicit join on other_data #' @depends {{{domain}}} USUBJID #' @outputs NEWCOL #' @code {{{domain}}} <- {{{domain}}} |>   dplyr::left_join(other_data) get_rendered_component(bad_file, list(domain = "ADAE")) #> Error in `abort_validation_errors()`: #> ! Component validation failed: #>  #> ! Implicit dplyr join(s) detected in rendered component: #> ✖ Join operations must explicitly specify the `by` argument #> ℹ Line 2: dplyr::left_join #' @title Good join example #' @description Explicit join that passes validation. #' #' @param domain `character` Name of the domain #' @type row #' @origin Derived #' @method Explicit join on other_data by USUBJID #' @depends {{{domain}}} USUBJID #' @outputs NEWCOL #' @code {{{domain}}} <- {{{domain}}} |>   dplyr::left_join(other_data, by = dplyr::join_by(USUBJID)) get_rendered_component(good_file, list(domain = "ADAE"))$code #> [1] "ADAE <- ADAE |>"                                              #> [2] "  dplyr::left_join(other_data, by = dplyr::join_by(USUBJID))"

text: get_test_component() creates component runs separate R session tracks code coverage. Use interactive checks unit tests testthat. default (check_coverage = TRUE), coverage checked calling environment ends, e.g. test_that() block. error raised line run. vignette test, sets check_coverage = FALSE. Assign input data test session: Run component get result: Every line code now run: testthat file, create test component inside test_that(), assign data, evaluate test results. Coverage checked test ends. See ?mighty_component_test workflow.

title: Component repos — mighty_repo
text: mighty_repo(): Create component repo spec. mighty_repo_class: Abstract parent class component repos. properties created directly. Specs form type::path. Supported types: local: local directory, e.g. local::inst/examples. spec without prefix treated local. github: GitHub repository, e.g. github::owner/repo/subdir@ref. See mighty_repo_github(). url: Raw files base URL, e.g. url::https://example.com/components. See mighty_repo_url(). repo types share one layout. component name file <name>.R <name>.mustache, either directly repo directory named component (<name>/<name>.R). name extension matches file.

title: GitHub component repo — mighty_repo_github
text: component repo hosted GitHub. object created, ref resolved commit SHA repository tarball commit downloaded extracted temporary directory. Resolved SHAs cached per ref tarballs per commit session, lookups afterwards local. Restart session pick new commits branch. spec remotes-style repository reference: owner/repo, owner/repo/subdir, owner/repo@ref combination. Transient API errors (HTTP 5xx network failures) retried. number attempts set max_tries option. See mighty.component-options. Requires gh remotes packages. Private repositories need GitHub token. gh reads GITHUB_PAT GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable, Git credential store. See gh::gh_token().

title: mighty.component (development version)
text: Breaking: component$id id list_components() now component name without file extension, e.g. "ady" instead "ady.mustache". Component repos S7 classes: mighty_repo(), mighty_repo_local(), mighty_repo_github() mighty_repos(). GitHub repos use github:: prefix (#108). find_component() exported, list_components() works repo types (#103). Components can retrieved URLs mighty_repo_url() (url:: prefix), time limit per request (timeout option) (#104). GitHub repos cached per commit, transient API errors retried (max_tries option) (#93, #95). @origin now required tag component headers (#107). New required @method tag component headers, exposed component$method (#107). @type row components accept ".mighty_subset(<domain>, '<subset>')" domain process matching rows; rows unchanged (#101).
